objective: Implement the GEE V1 R3 Delta Engine only: compare a trusted prior R2 context state with current canonical sources, preserve provenance, and fail closed when identity or critical inputs cannot be proven.

prerequisites.statement: GEE V1 R2 delivered: its sealed contract is intact and every declared artifact exists

invariants: Project-agnostic delta core; Wheel interpretation remains in the adapter
No mutation of R1 or R2 artifacts, contracts, seals or witnesses
Every delta and reusable fact retains provenance
Missing or unverifiable critical inputs fail closed
No R4 Evidence Graph, ledger, key, witness, release system or Git write
requiredNegativeTests: missing critical input, forged digest and unknown prior identity fail closed
requiredHostileOrCounterTests: controlled mutation, add/remove, dependency invalidation and unrelated change
invalidationDeclarations: This contract authorizes R3 Delta Engine only; R4 and later remain unauthorized.
